title: Breathe Underwater
description: A simple mod to let you breath under water without any potion effect Theres many dangers already, dont let the sea be other
body:
This mod allows you to breathe underwater without needing potions or displaying interfaces. Bubbles do not decrease and are updated every tick. This mod is ideal if you are looking for a simpler or more relaxed game mode so you can explore the depths of the ocean.

_Ideal with Cobblemon and the Cobbleverse modpack!_
